stories.title: New NHS accountability framework unveiled by Wales’ Health Minister
stories.summary: Problems in the Welsh NHS will be spotted and addressed before they become serious issues, Wales’ health minister has said. stories.title: Price cap rises to £1,723 as forecasters predict near £2,000 bills from January
stories.summary: Energy bills for households on standard tariffs will rise by 4 per cent from Thursday, with a further increase of about 16 per cent forecast for January.
